applicant.name: Dr. Florian Wagner
applicant.organisation: Ludwig Boltzmann Institute for Cardiovascular Prevention (non-profit research)

purpose: We investigate whether blood pressure control in older people with hypertension differs between hospitals and between men and women.
question: What is the mean systolic blood pressure of hypertensive patients aged 65 or over, by hospital and sex?
definitions: Hypertension = a diagnosis with ICD-10 code I10.
Systolic blood pressure = LOINC 8480-6; only the latest reading of each patient is used, patients without a reading are excluded.
Report per hospital and sex: number of patients with a reading and their mean systolic blood pressure in mm Hg, one decimal.
